message.content: As the context length increased, the model’s ability to retain and accurately reference earlier information deteriorated, leading to a noticeable decline in coherence and factual consistency. The longer the prompt, the more likely the model was to forget key details, misinterpret instructions, or generate redundant or irrelevant content, indicating that the system struggled to maintain a stable understanding of the full input. This degradation suggests that the model’s attention mechanism and memory capacity were insufficient to handle the extended context without loss of precision.
